title: phanera purpurea
intro: Phanera purpurea, commonly known as the Purple Phanera, is a plant species belonging to the family Sapindaceae. It is traditionally used in Ayurvedic medicine to treat various health conditions, including inflammation, fever, and respiratory issues, due to its potential health benefits such as antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Phanera purpurea include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant effects, which contribute to its use in treating respiratory conditions like bronchitis and asthma. The bioactive constituents of Phanera purpurea include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
